name: qwen-linux-port
description: Reproducible Linux x86_64 package for Qwen 1.0.2
author: qwen.ai

scripts.package:dir: npm run prepare:linux && electron-builder --linux dir --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run prepare:linux && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb pacman --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.test: npm run test:upstream && npm run verify:package && npm run verify:mcp
